columns.name: QUERY_ID
columns.description: The query to which this result belongs to.

columns.name: RESULT_ID
columns.description: The result to which this value is going to be assigned.

columns.name: RESULT_VALUE
columns.description: The actual result value of string data type to be returned.

columns.name: NUMBER_RESULT_VALUE
columns.description: Actual  query/rule result value of number data type to be returned.

columns.name: DATE_RESULT_VALUE
columns.description: Actual query/rule result value of date data type to be returned.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: If the result value is based on a table column, then this column stores the id of the table column (i.e the entity attribute reference).

columns.name: VALUESET_STRING_VALUE
columns.description: The result value of type string that the user selects from the valueset.

columns.name: VALUESET_NUMBER_VALUE
columns.description: Actual query/rule result value of type number that the user selects from the valueset.

columns.name: VALUESET_DATE_VALUE
columns.description: Actual query/rule result value of type date that the user selects from the valueset.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
